mission.label: Why We Are Here
mission.description: Frontline Journal is not a blog. It is a training ground for the Post-Junior era. AI generates code at scale, but it cannot think critically about quality. We prepare testers who don't just find bugs — they prevent them. Through hard QA fundamentals and an unfiltered look at the IT market, this is where theory meets practice.

qa.title: QA Fundamentals
qa.desc: Edge cases, UI anatomy, and the skeptic mindset. Learn to see what others miss.

reality.title: Reality Check
reality.desc: The market has changed. Understand the truth about salaries, AI, and survival in IT.

academy.title: Frontline Academy
academy.desc: Hands-on modules. Visual evidence rooms. Technical documentation drills. Theory is a liability without practice.

qa.label: 01. Quality Assurance
qa.quote: "It's not about finding bugs. It's about being the only person in the room brave enough to ruin everyone's mood."
qa.description: The reality of QA is 80% detective work on a bug that no one else can reproduce, and 20% fighting for quality. Here you will learn to think like the user, the developer, and the adversary — all at once.

mindset.title: Skeptic Mindset
mindset.desc: Pathological distrust of 'it works on my machine'. QA starts at the documentation level.

anatomy.title: UI Anatomy
anatomy.desc: Box models, component states, and typography. Learn to see the invisible structure of the web.

toolkit.title: Technical Toolkit
toolkit.desc: Figma, Jira, DevTools. The instruments we use to dissect, document, and debug reality.

academy.label: Frontline Academy
academy.description: The Academy is where Frontline Journal becomes practice. Each module is a hands-on training environment: visual evidence rooms, logic drills, and documentation workshops. No passive reading. You build skills by doing.

step1.title: The Lexicon
step1.desc: Terminology and visual evidence. Learn to identify every UI component state.

step2.title: Evidence Room
step2.desc: Visual bug hunting in simulated environments. Train your eye to spot what others miss.

step3.title: Construction
step3.desc: Master technical documentation. Write bug reports that developers actually want to read.

reality.label: 02. Reality Check
reality.dreamQuote: "You will build innovative products and change the world in a modern office."
reality.realityQuote: "You will debug code written 5 years ago and explain why the estimate was wrong."
reality.description: Technology is only 50% of success. The rest is navigating the market, understanding AI's impact, and filtering corporate jargon. Without this knowledge, even the best technical skills won't save you.

hype.title: The Hype Cycle
hype.desc: The gold rush is over. Bootcamp marketing is not reality.

ai.title: The AI Barrier
ai.desc: Machines write CRUD apps faster than juniors. What's your edge?

market.title: Market Dynamics
market.desc: Big Tech, startups, freelance. Every path has its price.

human.title: Human Survival
human.desc: Soft skills are the hard skills of the 2020s.

cta.label: Your Starting Line
cta.description: You don't need another tutorial. You need a survival plan. Start with QA fundamentals, face the market reality, and train in the Academy. The Post-Junior era rewards those who prepare.
